phrases.latin: Mitte caudam! Nōlī fēlem caudā trahere.
phrases.english: Let go of the tail! Don’t pull the cat by its tail.

phrases.latin: āversōs bovēs eximium quemque pulchritūdine caudīs in spēluncam trāxit
phrases.english: he dragged the finest-looking of the cattle backwards into his cave by their tails (Cacus stealing Hercules’ herd)

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 141, 142, 143, 280.
